thread:
maria: quick alert — we started seeing degraded embed quality + a small bump in 5xxs during tail bursts. I built a tiny hotfix (model-embed v2.4.1-mini) that adds a conservative eviction delay + quant tuning. Requesting an express mini-roll in the 22:10-22:20 UTC change window.

ben: can you drop the exact pin command + a one-line release blurb so PM can approve?

maria: Pin command: `/deploy pin model-embed:v2.4.1-mini --no-canary --note \"hotfix: eviction delay + quant tweak\"`

maria: Blurb: "v2.4.1-mini: mitigate tail-burst embedding failures by adding eviction delay and a quantization stability tweak."

emma: PM + comms ack. I'll post external note after deploy.

ops_oncall: I'll take the rollback gate. Rollback triggers: embed_drop_rate > 1.2% sustained for 4m OR p95 latency increase > 160ms over baseline for 5m. Also watch host_gc_ms and host_cpu_steal.

ben: small preflight: `http POST https://int-smoke/embed-check version=v2.4.1-mini samples=200` returned 0/200 errors, p95 118ms (baseline 120ms).

maria: plan: micro-roll 1% -> 30% -> 100% with immediate rollback on threshold. Skipping canary because the issue reproduces in heavy tail batching that the 10% canary flattens.

deploybot: Deploybot: deploy slot available at 22:12 UTC. To proceed run: `/deploy pin model-embed:v2.4.1-mini --no-canary --note "hotfix: eviction delay + quant tweak"`. Confirmers required: @emma @ops_oncall.

emma: Approving express mini-roll for 22:12. Posting changelog after success.

maria: kicking off at 22:12 now. @deploybot execute the pinned command.

deploybot: Started rollout at 22:12 UTC. Steps: 1% -> 30% -> 100% with monitors: embed_drop_rate, p95_latency, host_gc_ms, host_cpu_steal. Live: https://deploys.internal/1840004321

ops_oncall: 1% smoke good. No spike. p95 ~119ms.

ben: 30% step: tiny blip in embed_drop_rate localized to one AZ (1.0% instant), autoscaler replaced the host, metrics back to baseline. No customer-visible failures.

ops_oncall: holding 30% for 90s to confirm stability.

maria: logs show eviction delay preventing overlapping evictions; quant tweak reduced variance in outputs.

deploybot: Proceeding to 100% at 22:15 UTC.

ops_oncall: Post-deploy 6m window: embed_drop_rate = 0.45%, p95 latency = 122ms (+2ms). host_gc_ms stable, no cpu steal. No rollback required. Green. :white_check_mark:

emma: Published external note and internal release digest. Changelog blurb posted.

releasebot: Releasebot: changelog entry created: "2026-04-11  v2.4.1-mini: eviction delay + quant stability tweak to address tail-burst embedding issues."

maria: assigning a 1-day follow-up to add a synthetic tail-burst test to CI and to add the new metric (embed_drop_rate) to preflight smoke checks. Thanks team.

ben: nice quick runbook. can we add a short playbook line to the deploy doc advising 1% starter step for sensitive parity fixes?

emma: yes, filing a tiny docs PR now. Closing loop.
